semgrep-cloud-platform/scan.reason: Semgrep Cloud runs a server-side ruleset that no local hook reproduces, so a finding it raises cannot be cleared from a branch. The current finding, python.lang.security.audit.dangerous-subprocess-use-tainted-env-args, id 949800930, lands on the cmd argument of the subprocess.run call inside run_skill_knowledge in scripts/eval/eval-suite.py and is not exploitable: cmd is a list whose first element is sys.executable followed by a fixed script path, subprocess.run defaults to shell=False, and no shell parses the argv, so the rule's suggested shlex.quote would corrupt the value rather than protect it. Clearing the check needs a triage in the semgrep.dev org UI, which neither CI nor a branch can perform. Tracked on issue #5480. The finding id is recorded for a human auditor: the readiness check reads a check name from GitHub's check rollup and never sees which finding produced it, so nothing enforces that a future failure under this check name is this same finding. The pull_requests and expires bounds are what limit the blast radius.

Verify dispatch closure against base.reason: PR #7240 edits three files in the completion gate's dispatch closure on purpose to fix issues #7222 and #7230: src/claude/lib/github_core/api.py, src/claude/skills/github/scripts/pr/resolve_pr_review_thread.py, and the new src/claude/lib/github_core/review_thread_pager.py. The change makes paginated reads fail on any page error and pages every review thread, so verify_dispatch_closure.py reports DIFFERS against base (run 42966396101, 2026-11-11). PR #7244 edits src/claude/skills/pr-review/pr-review-config.yaml so its script paths use the plugin-root form for issue #7226 (run 42968471375, 2026-11-11; 1 of 60 closure files differs). The job docstring says a legitimate verifier change reports exactly this way and that the job is a report, not a gate. The owner approved this waiver for these two PRs on 2026-11-11. Earlier entries for PR #6797 and PR #7067 expired on 2026-11-11.

Renovate.reason: The Renovate job fails at its Verify BOT_PAT secret step because BOT_PAT is empty at run time, which no PR diff can change. A repo admin must set or rotate the secret. The owner approved this waiver on 2026-11-04 for these two PRs only, so any other Renovate PR still fails loudly until the secret is fixed.
